title: Validating Autoformalized Specifications via Contrapuntal Languages
data:
Y Dai, X Liu, H Jia, T Li, X Zhang, S Mechtaev- arXiv preprint arXiv:2610.30059, 2026
Formal specifications can make AI-generated code mechanically checkable. 
Because user intent is typically expressed in natural language rather than formal 
logic, specifications must first be derived from it, eg, via LLM-based 
autoformalization. Yet autoformalized specifications are themselves untrusted, so a 
key challenge is validating whether they capture user intent without relying on a
